en: Vintage sepia-toned panoramic postcard showing a wide view over the Danube River with a large suspension/chain bridge in the foreground, quays, riverside promenades and city buildings on both banks. A landscaped riverside park with curved paths appears at the lower right, and hills with further buildings rise in the distance. The title text at the side identifies the view as a panorama from Gellért Hill in Budapest.
